tools.description: Read and change the cells of a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb, nbformat 4) instead of its raw JSON. action read shows the cells with their index, id, type, source and outputs (text cut to a limit; images and other binary outputs named only). edit replaces a cell's source (and can change its type), insert adds a cell before index cell (or at the end), delete removes one. Pick a cell by cell (0-based index from a read) or cell_id. Editing a code cell's source clears its outputs and execution count, since they no longer match. The file is rewritten in Jupyter's own layout, so only the changed cell differs in a diff. Nothing is executed.

action.description: read shows cells; edit, insert and delete change the file.

cell.description: 0-based cell index. read: first cell to show (default 0). insert: the new cell goes before this index (default: at the end). edit and delete: the cell, unless cell_id is given.

cell_id.description: edit and delete: the cell's id, as a read shows it; takes precedence over cell.

cell_type.description: insert: the new cell's type (default code). edit: change the cell to this type.

count.description: read only: how many cells to show from cell (default: all).

path.description: Path of the .ipynb file, relative to cwd or absolute.

source.description: edit and insert: the cell's whole new source.

tools.name: notebook
